p01-wind.note: A raven let go into the gullies in the wind goes down among the crows in a pine and sits it out.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic night photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. Keep its landforms, but none of its smooth surfaces survive: blob trees become real Aleppo pines and tall cypresses, smooth ground real limestone, scree and scrub. NIGHT under a full moon with a strong wind blowing through a wooded gully: pines and cypresses bent over, branches streaming, dry grass flattened. In the nearest big pine, on a bare branch among a flock of a dozen black crows, sits one raven with a small pale tube tied to its leg, waiting out the wind; the birds hold still, feathers ruffled. No people, no tents, no fire. Deep focus. Nothing modern.
